response.sql: WITH combo AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_opt) AS baseline FROM combo), dev AS (SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.avg_opt, c.avg_opt - b.baseline AS deviation FROM combo c CROSS JOIN base b), typed AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev d WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_opt, deviation, deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind
